s1.quote: Jardines de la Reina (English: Gardens of the Queen) is an archipelago in the southern part of Cuba

notDiveSite.reason: An archipelago and national park, not a single dive site

s1.quote: The reef wall at Mogotes is between 14 and 18m deep. Below the wall was a shallow ledge, and, as with most walls in the area, you find dozens of schooling tarpon and circling reefs sharks.

highlights.text: Schooling tarpon and circling reef sharks
